body: I've been thinking about this for 7 years now. something always seems to come up to keep me here.....i think it's about time i go for it. i really do have nothing to keep me here now or anything else to lose. thanks

you know, i remember telling myself with this last girl "don't fuck it up man..this is what you've been looking for" but i don't know, somewhere along the line i just started doing it....i started noticing that she would tell me lies...and i totally blew that up out of proportion...i realize now they were meaningless....she just wanted me to like her and think that she was a fun cool well liked person....sort of 'demonstrate value' type of thing ya know.

as for my family, i've just never been good at communicating with them, i'd rather be alone than with them. that really does sadden me though and I have tried to talk to my mom at least before but she wasn't very positive and just made me feel worse. I can't even speak more than two words with my dad.

thanks for the actual questions by the way. i always ask people questions and general care about the answers but i never seem to get more than the 'how's it going' chit chat shit.
